sections: Global authority lock order and retained observations

repo_truth: The additive approval service and focused bounds/waiver tests are present, but the originating lane returned conditional with no successful dynamic ES256 service proof, incomplete-journal rollback gaps, approval-only use-chain discovery, and no narrow committed-approval observation for promotion. Registry mutation and lifecycle/promotion lanes are concurrently editing disjoint owned modules.
allowed_scope: Add a narrow crate-visible committed-approval validation/observation API for promotion and a cross-family recovery hook that the registry module can call without duplicating authority semantics.

Edit charter_authority_transaction.rs only if GitNexus impact is run first and only to replace the stale hard-coded shipped-profile fingerprint with exact current re-resolution or an equivalent authority-derived binding; coordinate before any overlapping edit.
non_goals: Do not edit registry-mutation, lifecycle-store, promotion-workflow, compiler, CLI, Flow, proof, control, handoff, or ledger files.
Do not weaken native CTAP/ES256 authority, retained locks, exact currentness, all-null refusal, or crash recovery.
Do not commit or write a global handoff.
tasks: Add a successful dynamic ES256 end-to-end approval service test plus forged, replay, stale/wrong-pair, and committed-journal authority negatives using the exact fake-port boundary.
Make incomplete pre-intent/staging recovery safely roll back owned partial state while preserving immutable orphans and evidence as required by the total table.
Expose the smallest crate-visible committed-approval journal validation API needed by promotion; orphan records without a matching committed journal must refuse.
Expose or implement the approval-family half of complete registry-then-approval use-journal discovery so the registry lane can compose one predecessor-ordered domain without family-local optimism.
Report the stale profile fingerprint integration defect with an exact remediation proposal if it cannot be safely changed within the allowed conditional scope.
contracts_and_gates: Locks and complete recovery precede randomness, native calls, and intent creation.
A matching 72-byte raw-intent-hash marker is the only approval authority commit point.
Successful proof verifies real ES256 with the committed registry key and exact challenge/request/response bytes.
Incomplete owned journal state follows the packet's rollback/roll-forward table and is idempotent.
Promotion accepts only approval refs proven by matching committed approval journals.
stop_conditions: Stop before any HIGH/CRITICAL existing-symbol edit and report the blast radius to the parent.
Return blocked rather than overlap an active lane or weaken an exact authority contract.
